name: EH3D-COMPONENT-INTELLIGENCE
notes: Scaffolding v0.0.2: early code. Technical database of electronic components in which every value carries its provenance: a Rust library and command line that read a JSON database, find duplicate identities, observations without a source, sources that disagree, records marked verified while something is pending and records without a recorded origin or licence, and refuse to export data without a licence. It also imports a CSV list of parts into a JSON database file kept next to the project, with bounded reading and stable refusal codes. It has only been tested with data made by its own tests and small example files; other import formats and the link with the symbols and footprints of the design tool are not written.
